test_title: PYST 45 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In the following question, four letter-number pairs are given. The letter-number on the left side of (-) is related to the letter-number on the right side of (-) with some Logic/Rule/Relation. Three pairs are similar on the basis of same Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4c28d9f01eafe94a87d2ee0dd6a7029e538ee84ea22407c32952fdad6eb8fc7.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Letters:** Each letter shifts by a fixed position value.

**Numbers:** Right number = (Left number × 3) − 1

For 'SD206 - PX617':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8609cfcda455d4207ec6a450c6e7366b6a734a18c3f52fc47fb00df296e7166a.png] 

For 'MB194 - JV581':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68e35b77999330635c51ff3605e21ce690f639220777f5cc957c6474aec9a253.png] 

For 'LT187 - IN560':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/975d2792c5f0b0410b9b1ecc405d3f0a7d3586e95f18a42d990088eed24a4c07.png] 

**For 'FS313 - CO938':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3530e589a7cfb34b0f0a2dc1f17a29929b6efcf6dc7913385f416094e5d09a84.png] 

'FS313 - CO938' is the ODD ONE OUT.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
